purpose: One offline own-trajectory deployment audit of all frozen B/C/D/E actors; no training, future test, admission, registration or account writes.
runtime_loading: Import complete actual hash-bound core.gold.policy_runtime module, classes, helpers and constants. Do not extract infer alone or import application/Store/Registry instances.
actor_conversion: Copy each frozen native JSON actor without changing weights, scaler, dataset, cutoff, input arm, seed or training budget. Set only explicit f64 protocol, raw_f64_observation input, arithmetic and margin metadata; bind original actor SHA and independent study-arm identity. Format validation is not admission.
trajectory: Each case starts with its own initial cash and zero inventory, advances actual GoldEnv or original hold simulator and keeps complete fills/equity. Runtime observations use its own raw-bid peak; GoldEnv stress marking uses scenario-widened bid. Disclose this semantic difference; it is not purely floating-point drift.
native_comparison: For each policy decision use actual research portable f32 actor_action on the matching case's own GoldEnv observation, outside the timed deployment inference. Record accepted-action differences and refusals separately. Original Torch parity evidence does not prove parity on this new trajectory.
refusal: Invoke actual infer with 100ms monotonic deadline and the actual production post-return deadline check. Timeout, low margin and other refusals consume the close, make no order, preserve cash/inventory/basis/realized PnL/fill count, and still advance marks/time. Never retry, substitute target-zero, EMA, old action or another model.
comparison_scope: Hash-bound native study metrics, complete fills/equity and action counts are diagnostic financial references. New D/E have no inherited f64 reference. Report every result, source/semantic difference and timing failure; do not require bitwise vectors or zero timeouts to erase valid evidence or invent a profit gate.
run_policy: Freeze reviewed source/input/bootstrap/command hashes before one full Linux run. Partial local sanity is explicitly partial. Preserve all failures; an observation timeout is not a reason to restart a live handle. Never repeat to choose a zero-timeout result.
future_confirmation: Separate predeclaration must bind the exact deployed actors, same-source Swissquote samples, complete control set, fixed future start/end and original return/drawdown/nondegeneracy gates before inspecting that future window. 100-hour warmup, this already-seen audit and fixed-vector equality do not grant qualification.
